episodes.207941: Showers and thunderstorms ahead of a cold front affected the coastal waters during the early morning hours of December 2nd.  Storms were in a mix of a squall line and individual cells ahead of the line. A few measured gusts in excess of 34 knots were measured along the coast with a peak gust of 46 knots measured at a private weather station along the Gulf county coast.
episodes.208143: Showers and thunderstorms ahead of a cold front affected the coast during the early morning hours of December 2nd. Storms were in a mix of a squall line and individual cells ahead of the line. A few measured gusts in excess of 40 mph were measured along the coast with the peak gust of 53 mph measured at a private weather station along the Gulf county coast. Some power outages due to the storms occurred on Cape San Blas.
